description: Reads a LiveDoc from its current or requested repository revision and returns `{markdown, outline}`; embedded Work Items are rendered with their title and description. Use this for the full document body; use `get_document_outline` for headings only or `read_document_section` for one section. Requires a project ID, space ID, and document name the signed-in Polarion user can read.

document.description: LiveDoc name within the space, not a composite project/space/document path.

projectId.description: Polarion project ID that owns the LiveDoc, such as `PROJECT`.

revision.description: Repository revision to read; omit to use the current revision.

spaceId.description: Document space ID within the project, such as `Specifications`.

name: read_document_markdown
title: Read LiveDoc as Markdown
